title: Adjacency List vs Adjacency Matrix
question: What are the two main ways to represent a graph in Java? Compare their time and space complexity.
searchIntent: adjacency list vs adjacency matrix java interview
realWorldScenario: Adjacency list is O(V+E) space — preferred for sparse graphs (social networks). Matrix is O(V²) — for dense graphs or fast edge-lookup.

when to use directed graph java
realWorldScenario: Social follows = directed (A follows B ≠ B follows A). Friendship = undirected (symmetric).

realWorldScenario: Store List<int[]> {neighbor, weight} per node, or use a custom Edge class for clarity in Dijkstra's algorithm.
